title: Operation Raise Filo: Emergency Edition
text: “The lottery ticket we provided clearly states that the contents of the egg the Hero purchased are indeed a Filolial.”
“This is?”
“Kweeeh!”

Father was giving Filo-tan her food, I say. After that, Father continued the performance with the monster merchant most admirably. Filo-tan tilted her head slightly while glaring at Older Sister. According to Father, apparently there needed to be a grown woman standing beside him. If there wasn’t one, Filo-tan would end up in her adult form. That was likely why, in the loop where Father had purchased Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy, Filo-tan’s build had come out so large. Come to think of it, when Sakura-chan stayed in Melromarc until she grew up… there hadn’t been any adult women around her. So that must be why she ended up growing up. But Yuki-chan and Kou… I had been the one taking care of them. If we applied this rule, what would happen if, say, we entrusted Kou to Father and had him raised until reaching his angelic form? Would he end up as a tall, blue-eyed version of Kou? And what about Yuki-chan… in her case, I had a feeling she’d end up looking something like a white swan. So many possibilities, indeed. Even with just one Filolial-sama, the differences could be this vast.
“Well then, I’ll come pick it up tomorrow. Have your answer ready by then.”
At this, Filo-tan let out a scream, as if to say don’t leave me behind, I say.
“Kweh—”

Oh my? She seemed to be waving as if to say see you later… indeed? In any case… time to retreat for now. Since we’d already told them Filo-tan might act up, the monster merchant had prepared accordingly.
After that, heh heh… once night fell, it would be time to reunite with Filo-tan, indeed.
“You’ve had that creepy little smirk plastered on your face this whole time. It’s gross.”
“Honestly… someone ought to spare a thought for the poor souls dragged into this absurd farce.”
“Sounds like it’s necessary, but rough all the same.”
“Wow?”
Rabbit Guy and the others were muttering about me from over by the circus tent, but I paid them no mind, I say.
“So that’s Motoyasu-sama’s precious Filolial.”

Hiiii… Yuki-chan. Was it just my imagination, or did her presence feel somehow frightening? When I’d been making Rabbit Guy burst out laughing earlier, I’d completely erased my scent, but now Yuki-chan was accompanying me.
“Indeed. I do hope you two can get along.”
I offered what support I could. Ah, though Yuki-chan-as-white-swan did have a rival streak, her presence hadn’t been frightening like this. Was it just my imagination?
“From a distance, she looks like a female version of Kou. No, actually, she seems a bit more energetic.”
“Yuki-chan. Filo-tan is pure of heart, I say. Kou too is pure, everyone is a pure little angel, indeed. And of course, that includes you too, Yuki-chan.”

Everyone was a pure little angel, indeed. Now that I thought about it, this loop’s Kou, perhaps influenced by Elephant and the sisters, seemed noticeably more serious compared to previous loops. His desire to protect the little ones was front and center, and he really was more well-behaved than in other loops. But since it meant he wouldn’t be on the receiving end of Father’s discipline, there was no problem at all, I say. He’d grown into a child who loved playing with the sisters, after all.
“Understood. This Yuki shall guide you both firmly as your leader!”
“Wow…”

“Wolf, I understand you want to go see Iwatani-sama, but if you carelessly go meet him now, the Spear Hero will chase you down, you know? If he holds a grudge, who knows what he’ll do… he’ll definitely chase you to the ends of the earth at that running speed of his.”
“Kyaiin… kuuun…”
The commotion behind me was quite noisy, I say.
“Kweh, kwekwe.”
Oh, Filo-tan was waiting obediently in the tent, I say. It was probably just my imagination that she seemed to be talking to someone.

And so, as night began to fall, Filo-tan, perhaps out of boredom, started kicking the cage and causing a ruckus. So Father and the others came over. Naturally, everything proceeded exactly according to plan, indeed.
“What’s the matter? We had an agreement to hold onto it until tomorrow, didn’t we?”
“That was the intention, but the Hero’s monster has proven to be somewhat troublesome.”
“Kweeeh!”

Let’s play! Filo-tan seemed to be shouting from inside the cage, or so it sounded. Ah, this nostalgic loop. This was the very moment I’d discovered that as long as Older Sister was present, everything would be fine, I say.
“……sama.”
Ah, the long-awaited Filo-tan, indeed. This was the moment where Father and the others’ research would prove whether or not it truly became Filo-tan.
“Hm? Did I just hear an unfamiliar voice?”
“I believe I heard something similar as well.”
“Oh my~?”
Older Sister, where exactly are you looking? More importantly, it was Filo-tan in her angelic form! I leapt out from the shadows and rushed straight toward Filo-tan, indeed!

Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Father Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Father Father Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Father Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Filo-tan Father Filo-tan!
『How many times do you intend to call my name in the middle of all that Filo-chanting!? Focus!』
『Waaah……』
In my mind, I could picture Father and the others recoiling for some reason, but surely that was just my imagination.
“Filoooooo-taaaaaaan――”
“Wh-what what!? Yaaaaaah――too bad! It’s me!”
“Whaaat!? Indeed!?”

Just as I’d gripped Filo-tan tight and was nuzzling my cheek against her, the one I’d thought was Filo-tan peeled back the skin of its face with a rip, like some kind of phantom thief dropping a disguise, and revealed its true form. What appeared there was… only the face, but it seemed to be a Raph-species crafted from Big Sister’s own hair!? A bizarre monstrosity with Filo-tan’s body and only the face of a Raph-species, indeed.
“Gyaaaaah!? Indeed!?”
“It’s been a while, Spear Hero.”
Just what in the world was going on here!? Why, when I should have hugged Filo-tan, was there a medium-sized Raph-species instead? No, wait, was this perhaps Big Sister in her Raph beastfolk form?
“What are you doing~?”
Behind it, Filo-tan tilted her head, watching us. Th-this was just what exactly!?
“Just who in the world are you, indeed!?”
“What an unenthusiastic response. I thought you’d already understood that it was me who’d come.”
Boom! The Raph-species that had, until its neck, been Filo-tan transformed into a medium-sized Raph-species build and stood upright on two legs.
“Um…… you said it’s someone Motoyasu-kun knows, but is it someone I don’t know?”
“This one here is dreadfully dense, after all. No doubt it’ll mistake who I am.”
“Could you be Big Sister, indeed?”
“Too bad, wrong answer. I demand a correction.”
Th-this manner of speech… no, more importantly, right now it was all about Filo-tan, indeed!
“Filo-taaaan!”
And so, I dove toward Filo-tan, who was standing behind it, indeed!
“Nyaaaaaah――too bad, that’s me too!”
Rip! Just as I’d thought it was Filo-tan, it turned out to be another Raph-species! Just what in the world was going on here!?
